I farm rice here in the middle belt, and rice needs feeding well or it will not give good yield. I will buy a little NPK and urea — maybe one bag of each for this small plot — because without fertilizer the rice will not fill the grains. I do not have money for improved seed from agro-dealer this year, so I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, but I will spray herbicide because weeding rice by hand alone is too much work. My family will do most of the work, but for transplanting and harvest I must call some hands to help.
